scenes: The man who built Nvidia just quit. Effective immediately.
Jensen Huang resigned as C E O and left the board. No reason given.
He co-founded Nvidia in nineteen ninety-three, at a Denny's.
Last year, it became the first company worth five trillion dollars.
Reports said he had an affair. The woman is now accused of spying for China.
The Information linked her to firms that helped ship chips to China.
Then The New York Times reported a second affair, with an Nvidia executive.
Nvidia's board met into the evening to decide his fate.
In a memo, he wrote: I was unfaithful to my wife. I am deeply sorry.
Nvidia stock fell as much as thirteen percent.
Yahoo Finance estimated about four hundred forty billion dollars wiped out.
C F O Colette Kress is now interim C E O.
Nvidia without its founder. Still on top?
